responsibility: Public header for GCC-specific Go backend factory entry points. It declares the constructors that let the frontend obtain the concrete GCC implementations of the abstract `Backend` and `Linemap` services, serving as the minimal interface boundary used by the language hook layer to instantiate the Go frontend’s backend-dependent components.
same_name_distinction: Declares the small public factory interface for the Go GCC backend, exposing go_get_backend and go_get_linemap to the rest of the frontend; unlike go-gcc.cc, it does not implement lowering logic or backend wrapper classes.
